title: Hook instructable v1
description: An owner ask as exact steps. Hook's validator (and any compatible mailbox) is the source of truth: it also rejects secret-like values (sk-ant-, sk-..., xox[abp]-, ghp_, github_pat_, PEM private keys, AKIA...), hidden characters and documents over 32768 bytes, which JSON Schema cannot express. Steps plus sub-steps total at most 60. At most 20 of them ask a question; verify never does.

items.description: A web page (url) or a local document (path), exactly one of the two.

localPath.description: An absolute path on the owner's Mac (/... or ~/...), one line.

question.description: A question for the owner on this step, answered in Hook without closing the ask. No choices asks for free text; multi allows several picks and needs at least 2 choices. Read the answers with relay_status, relay status or relay wait.

verify.description: The final check. Like a sub-step, but it never asks a question.

detail.description: Longer instructions for this step, shown as wrapped text under do. Put explanations here, never in code: code is only text to copy exactly.

leaf.description: A sub-step: one action, shown indented as 3a, 3b. It may ask a question.

detail.description: Longer instructions for this step, shown as wrapped text under do. Put explanations here, never in code: code is only text to copy exactly.

blocking.description: The next steps can't start without this one: the owner can't open later steps until it is done. Use only when later steps fail without it, and give the reason in warning.

warning.description: A caution shown in a box on this step; line breaks allowed. With blocking, the reason the next steps wait.

optional.description: The owner may finish this step without doing or answering it, e.g. a feedback question or a nice-to-have. Never together with blocking. On a step with substeps it makes every sub-step optional, so none of them may be blocking.

file.description: A document for the owner to read, usually Markdown, which Hook opens rendered. Write the document to a file and point to it here instead of pasting it into detail.

step.description: A step. When it needs more than one action, its actions go in substeps, shown indented and ticked one by one.
